Content: A student is writing a report about dolphins for a science assignment. The student needs to revise the draft of the report to eliminate ideas that do not support the main idea.
:ibox:Main idea: Dolphins are mammals that have adapted to live in the ocean.
Choose `bbtext(two)` sentences that do not support the main idea and so should be removed.

A.Choice: All mammals, including dolphins, share certain features.

B.Choice: Since dolphins are mammals, they give birth to live babies.

C.Choice: Like all mammals, dolphins produce milk for their young, are warm-blooded, and have hair.

D.Choice: Cold-blooded animals cannot control their body temperature.

E.Choice: Unlike fish, which have gills, dolphins breathe air using lungs.

G.Choice: Dolphins must make trips to the ocean's surface to breathe.

H.Choice: The blowhole on a dolphin's head acts as a “nose” making it easy for the dolphin to get air.

Content: A student is writing an opinion letter to her teacher about snacks in her classroom. Read a draft of the letter and complete the task that follows.

:ibox:Dear Mrs. Johnson,

I am writing to make a suggestion that you allow us students to keep healthy snacks in our desks to eat whenever we want. During class we are often hungry, and it distracts us from our work. If we could have a snack whenever we wanted one instead of just at snack time, I think we would be able to concentrate better on our assignments. In addition, healthy snacks are good brain food. Therefore, they would help us finish our work on time and get better grades. I know you might say that the room would be too messy with all of the snacking going on, but I bet that students would agree to clean up after themselves if they could have snacks when they wanted them.

Sincerely,
Tina Young
Which sentence is the `bbtext(best)` closing statement for this student's letter?

A.Choice: Please allow us to bring snacks that are easy to clean up and keep in our desks until snack time.

B.Choice: Please think about requiring students to bring only healthy snacks to school for snack time so that they will get better grades.

C.Choice: Please consider my request to keep healthy snacks that are easy to clean up in our desks so that we can have them when we are hungry and focus on our work.

D.Choice: Please ask all of the students if they would like to bring something healthy for snack time every day so that they can focus on their work.

A student is writing a research report about the Grand Canyon. Read the sentences from his report and the directions that follow.

:ibox:Many animals live in the Grand Canyon. These animals need the Colorado River, which runs at the bottom of the canyon. The river gives the animals water to drink and a place to swim. Because lots of plants grow near the river, plant-eating animals can easily locate food there. Many people travel to the river in the Grand Canyon hoping to see the many different types of animals who live there.
Select `bbtext(all)` of the sources that would most likely give the student more information about the ideas he has written.

A.Choice:
`ultext(www.tripstothecanyon.com)`
Visit the Grand Canyon with your family. There are many things you can see on your trip. Let us help you plan your trip now!

B.Choice:
`ultext(www.canyonrivertravel.com)`

C.Choice:

Content: A student is writing a research report about musical instruments. He wrote an opinion in the report. Read the opinion and the directions that follow.

:ibox:There are many kinds of musical instruments, and it can be hard to choose which `text(one)` to learn how to play. The sound of an instrument is also important to consider when choosing an instrument. For example, some people like the trumpet for its very loud sound.
